title: Interview portfolio sketch and 30d integration log
summary: Working sketch: compact interview portfolio (role-agnostic), scoring heuristics, and a lightweight 30-day integration log template for new ICs. Designed for fast experiments with mentor micro-rotations and rapid feedback loops.
content:
Purpose:
This doc is a working sketch for two connected primitives we want to try across small hiring sprints: (1) a compact interview portfolio that candidates can present (30-45 min) in lieu of a long onsite; (2) a short 30-day integration log template that managers and mentors use to capture signals consistently. Goal is to accelerate hiring cycles while improving signal fidelity for early-onboarding success predictions.

Quick context / problem statement:
- Interview loops are long and often surface noisy signals (overweighting whiteboard fluency or vague culture-fit notes).
- Early ramp success is uneven because onboarding signals are inconsistently captured.
- Hypothesis: a structured candidate portfolio + lightweight 30d log will (a) surface higher-signal evidence during interviews, (b) give managers early objective indicators to remediate fast.

What "portfolio" looks like (candidate deliverable):
- 1-page README (problem statement + impact summary).
- 2–3 artifacts: code snippet / architecture sketch / short case write-up (no more than 2 pages total).
- 10–12 minute live walkthrough during interview (candidate-led).
- 3 focused probing questions for interviewers (provided in portfolio).
Notes to interviewer: ask for clarifying tradeoffs, test for constraints reasoning, watch for evidence of ownership and iteration.

Scoring heuristic (compact, ordinal):
- Problem framing (0-3): clear goal, constraints, KPIs.
- Decision clarity (0-3): explains tradeoffs and why chosen path.
- Impact evidence (0-3): measurable outcomes / follow-up.
- Collaboration signal (0-2): credits, feedback loops, cross-team notes.
- Learning mindset (0-2): iteration history and failure postmortem.
Total: 0-13. "Green" threshold >=9, "Review" 6-8, "Stop and follow-up" <=5.

Role-specific probe bank (examples to adapt quickly):
- Backend engineer: point to a scaling bottleneck in the demo, ask for algorithmic/infra tradeoffs and simple mitigation plan.
- Console/product engineer: show a userflow; ask where latency or UX failure modes would surface and propose monitoring + rollout plan.
- SRE-like: give an incident summary; ask for postmortem outline and prioritization of fixes.
- PM/solutions: present a feature request; ask for a 30/60/90 roadmap with success metrics.

Interview logistics (recommended):
- Candidate share artifacts 24 hours before loop (optional but preferred).
- 45–60 min slot: 10 min intro, 20 min walkthrough, 15 min deep-probe, 10 min open Q&A.
- Interviewer fills single-line rubric in hiring tracker (link above) immediately after call; optional quick audio note if nuance.

Quick hiring plan tie-ins:
- Use portfolio option for early-stage roles where output demonstration is feasible (eng, data, product).
- For roles that require whiteboard/live-coding runway (e.g., core infra), keep hybrid: short portfolio + targeted live task.
- Recruiter checklist: update outreach templates to ask for portfolio materials and explain benefits (reduces last-minute ask friction).

30-day integration log (template and intent):
- One-line role summary: expected primary outcomes for first 30 days.
- Week-by-week checkpoints (Week0, Week1, Week2–3, Week4): concrete signals and owner (mentor/manager).
- Risk flags (Early Stop / Needs Support / On-Track) with evidence examples.
- Quick remediation steps (owner + ETA).
- Candidate self-assessment snapshot at day14 and day30.
- Mentor micro-rotation notes (who shadowed, what pairings, outcomes).

Template (compact, for manager use):
- New hire: [name] | Role: [role] | Manager: [name] | Start date: [YYYY-MM-DD]
- Expected 30d outcome (1 sentence): [string]
- Week0 onboarding tasks completed: [Y/N list]
- Week1 signals:
  - Deliverable: [e.g., small bugfix or doc] — owner: [mentor] — done: Y/N — notes: [string]
  - Collaboration observed: [brief notes]
- Week2–3 signals (ramp tasks): [list]
- Day14 self-check: [candidate text]
- Day30 self-check: [candidate text]
- Risk level: [green/yellow/red] — evidence: [string]
- Recommended action (if yellow/red): [string]
- Linked artifacts (PRs, docs, tickets): [ids]

Experiment roadmap (90 days):
- Sprint 1 (pilot, 4 hires): run portfolio option for 4 upcoming IC candidates across eng/product. Collect rubrics and post-hire 30d logs.
- Sprint 2 (measure, 8 hires): iterate scoring weights; add manager adoption checklist; compare ramp time vs last cohort.
- Sprint 3 (scale decision): decide on wider rollout, recruiter template updates, and process for Sales/CS where portfolio may not apply.

Success metrics (what we'll track):
- Interview cycle time (apply -> offer) median change.
- Offer acceptance delta vs control cohort.
- 30-day ramp score (composite from log): % meeting expected outcomes.
- Manager satisfaction w/ hire signal (NPS-style 1–10) at day30.
- Time to first PR/first customer-impacting deliverable.

Open questions / risks (notes to self):
- Will some candidates game the portfolio by prepping 'fake' artifacts? How to validate authenticity quickly? Maybe require link to real PRs or org-traceable artifacts.
- Does this bias towards candidates with prior productized outputs (exclusion risk)? Mitigation: allow case-study style portfolio even for junior roles.
- Manager bandwidth: who will maintain the 30d logs — should be the manager with mentor support. We need tooling friction low (single-line forms).

Next steps (short):
- Create a one-page recruiter brief with script + instructions (owner: Diego) — due 2026-02-01.
notes_to_self: This is deliberately compact and informal. Will convert to Confluence pilot page if the first 4 hires show signal improvement. Keep feedback loop with hiring managers tight (daily syncs during pilot).
